rows.sidho_kanho_birsha_university_skbu_purul: Junior-I: Rs. 14,000 + HRA per month; Junior-II: Rs. 31,000 + HRA per month
Department of Physics, Sidho-Kanho-Birsha University, Purulia

Junior-I: M.Sc. (not earlier than 3 years) with minimum 55% marks in the concerned subject. Junior-II: same plus valid JEST/GATE/NET-JRF/Lectureship/UGC-CSIR NET JRF/Lectureship and Ph.D. registration under the PI.
Maximum 28 years (as on the closing date of the advertisement)

content_sections.heading: SKBU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. R/Advt/Physics/2609/SKBU/26 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download SKBU notification PDF

content_sections.text: Other conditions: No TA/DA admissible for interview.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for SKBU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form and/or bringing any influence, political or otherwise, will be treated as a disqualification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initially for one year, may be extended on yearly basis subject to a total period of three years Appointment purely temporary; terminates automatically without notice on termination of the research project No claim of appointment/absorption in Funding Agency or in the University Appointment governed by terms and conditions of the funding agency applicable to the project Selected candidates must join duty immediately on receipt of the offer letter

content_sections.heading: How Will SKBU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on qualifications and relevant experience over and above the minimum prescribed Interview at Sidho-Kanho-Birsha University Short list prepared considering qualifications and relevant experience over and above the minimum prescribed Shortlisted candidates called for interview at Sidho-Kanho-Birsha University and informed through e-mail No TA/DA admissible for appearing for the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Resume/CV in the prescribed format Brief write up about motivation for pursuing research in physics

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SKBU Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Send Resume/CV by e-mail to [email protected] on or before November 26, 2026 (5:00 PM). CV format: Name, Father's Name, Date of Birth, Age, Category, Address of Communication, Email ID, Mobile no. Include educational qualifications from class 10 onwards, other academic achievements (if any) and experience. Include a brief write up about motivation for pursuing research in physics. Mention all qualifications and experience in the relevant field at the time of applying. Email it on or before 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SKBU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SKBU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for CRS Project Fellow (Junior)-I or II.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SKBU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 26 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years (as on the closing date of the advertisement). Relaxation: Reserve category As per the rules of Government of India.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Junior-I: Rs. 14,000 + HRA per month; Junior-II: Rs. 31,000 + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Junior-I: M.Sc. (not earlier than 3 years) with minimum 55% marks in the concerned subject. Junior-II: same plus valid JEST/GATE/NET-JRF/Lectureship/UGC-CSIR NET JRF/Lectureship and Ph.D. registration under the PI.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA admissible for interview.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Canvassing in any form and/or bringing any influence, political or otherwise, will be treated as a disqualification.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on qualifications and relevant experience over and above the minimum prescribed. Interview at Sidho-Kanho-Birsha University. Short list prepared considering qualifications and relevant experience over and above the minimum prescribed. Shortlisted candidates called for interview at Sidho-Kanho-Birsha University and informed through e-mail.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially for one year, may be extended on yearly basis subject to a total period of three years. Appointment purely temporary; terminates automatically without notice on termination of the research project. No claim of appointment/absorption in Funding Agency or in the University.
